flows.name: Inspect project scopes and table controls
steps: Inspect desktop scope tabs, table controls, and create action
flows.expectedOutcome: Desktop tabs and controls share one row, the create action is fully visible, and mobile remains overflow-safe.

checks: Scope tabs and controls share a row on desktop

claims.description: Desktop tabs and table controls share the unified row, and the create action is visible.
Mobile uses the shared compact settings control with no horizontal overflow.
A focused contract prevents the layout flags and primary action from regressing.
